note: BH-9938 (BH-9926 wave 6): settings row lane.pipeline-health.gh_source. Where pipeline-health reads the open-PR list (ph_open_list, ph_open_rows), the stale-dequeue block's merge-queue label list, Mergify payload and head commit time, and the lead-merge-unqueued block's combined status: off = GitHub only (today's reads); shadow (default) = the PR record and GitHub, the lane acts on GitHub and logs one PRR_SHADOW line in logs/prr-shadow.log when they differ; record = the PR record only, 0 GitHub calls on a hit, and a record miss reads GitHub and logs PRR_MISS. Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. Read by prr_step in bin/lib/prr-shadow.sh; the reads are bin/lib/prr-shadow.d/pipeline-health.sh.
